Generate Python code based on the following instruction. Output ONLY code. DO NOT include explanations or other textual content.
Instruction: Generate code that sets up a self-consistent fluid DREAM run, where no kinetic equations are solved, but the electric field and temperature are evolved self-consistently. The code should import necessary modules and classes from the DREAM library, set up the simulation parameters, set up the radial grid, set the time stepper, add ions, set the electric field and cold electron temperature, set up the hot tail grid, disable the runaway grid, set the solver type and its parameters, and include other necessary settings. The code should then save these settings to an HDF5 file and run the simulation. After the initial run, the code should restart the simulation twice, each time loading the settings from the output of the previous run, adjusting the time stepper, and saving the new settings to an HDF5 file before running the simulation again.

```python
import DREAM
from DREAM import DREAMSettings, runiface
from DREAM.Settings.RadialGrid import RadialGrid
from DREAM.Settings.Equations import EquationSystem
from DREAM.Settings.Equations.Ions import Ions
from DREAM.Settings.Equations.ElectricField import ElectricField
from DREAM.Settings.Equations.ColdElectrons import ColdElectrons
from DREAM.Settings.Equations.HotElectronDistributionFunction import HotElectronDistributionFunction
from DREAM.Settings.Equations.RunawayElectronDistributionFunction import RunawayElectronDistributionFunction
from DREAM.Settings.Solver import Solver
from DREAM.Settings.TimeStepper import TimeStepper

# --- Initial DREAM run ---

ds = DREAMSettings()

# Radial grid
ds.radialgrid.setNr(10)
ds.radialgrid.setMinorRadius(0.22)
ds.radialgrid.setWallRadius(0.23)
ds.radialgrid.setB0(2.1)

# Time stepper
ds.timestep.setTmax(1e-3)
ds.timestep.setNt(10)

# Add ions (example: deuterium plasma)
ds.eqsys.addIon(name='D', Z=1, n=2e19, iontype=Ions.IONTYPE_DYNAMIC)

# Electric field: evolve self-consistently
ds.eqsys.E_field.setType(ElectricField.TYPE_SELFCONSISTENT)
ds.eqsys.E_field.setInitialProfile(0.1)  # V/m

# Cold electron temperature: evolve self-consistently
ds.eqsys.T_cold.setType(ColdElectrons.TYPE_SELFCONSISTENT)
ds.eqsys.T_cold.setInitialProfile(10)  # eV

# Hot tail grid: required but not solved
ds.hottailgrid.setEnabled(False)

# Runaway grid: disable kinetic runaway
ds.runawaygrid.setEnabled(False)

# Solver settings
ds.solver.setType(Solver.LINEAR)
ds.solver.setMaxIterations(100)
ds.solver.setTolerance(1e-6)

# Save settings and run
ds.save('settings_run0.h5')
runiface(ds, 'output_run0.h5')

# --- First restart ---

ds1 = DREAMSettings()
ds1.fromOutput('output_run0.h5')

# Adjust time stepper for restart
ds1.timestep.setTmax(ds1.timestep.tmax + 1e-3)
ds1.timestep.setNt(10)

ds1.save('settings_run1.h5')
runiface(ds1, 'output_run1.h5')

# --- Second restart ---

ds2 = DREAMSettings()
ds2.fromOutput('output_run1.h5')

# Adjust time stepper for restart
ds2.timestep.setTmax(ds2.timestep.tmax + 1e-3)
ds2.timestep.setNt(10)

ds2.save('settings_run2.h5')
runiface(ds2, 'output_run2.h5')
```
